one_liners.one_liner: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon extends the Gemini flagship line as frontier releases cluster this week.
DeepSeek announced v4, its newest model release, through the API changelog this week.
Moonshot AI released Kimi K3 as an open-weight frontier model, keeping open weights competitive at the top end.
one_liners.take: Open weights at the frontier is still a strategy, not a compromise.

one_liners.one_liner: Removing conditional memory tables from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points, and low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first.
Claude Opus 5.5 (High) sits at rank 2 on LMArena's text leaderboard with a 1516 rating.
Anima's deployment shows care teams using OpenAI models to expand capacity for patient response.
OpenAI's ChatGPT agent turns the chatbot into a tool-using mode that browses and acts for subscribers.
OpenAI's first custom silicon, fabricated with Broadcom, signals frontier labs want control of their own supply.
one_liners.take: First-party silicon is what a lab builds when it stops trusting merchant GPU supply.

one_liners.one_liner: The oversubscribed round backs an autonomous factory network the company calls the first of its kind in America.
One of China's largest rounds landed days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove DeepSeek's technology.
Regulatory approval puts Amazon Leo's satellite-broadband buy of Globalstar over the line.
Hummingbird buys machine-learning detection for AML monitoring, deepening its financial-crime compliance stack.
Morningstar's bubble-size math and Ed Zitron's viral essay made the AI-bubble argument the week's biggest industry fight.
one_liners.headline: Is the AI bubble bigger than the booms before it?

one_liners.one_liner: Developer anger over Claude's hidden tool actions and Cloudflare's crawler accusation against Perplexity put AI transparency under fire.
one_liners.headline: Should AI companies have to show what their models and crawlers do?

sentences: Frontier model releases arrived in a cluster this week, with new entries from Google DeepMind, DeepSeek, and Moonshot AI landing inside days of one another.
The week's benchmark story is conditional memory: removing Engram-style hashed n-gram tables from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points.
Capital kept flowing at scale, as Foundry Robotics took in an oversubscribed $100 million Series A and DeepSeek reportedly raised $15 billion days after U.S. restrictions.
Amazon Leo's $11.5B Globalstar acquisition cleared a regulator, while Hummingbird bought Quantimon to fold machine learning into AML transaction monitoring.
OpenAI moved on two fronts, shipping a tool-using ChatGPT agent and unveiling its first custom chip built with Broadcom.
The sharpest argument was over whether AI is a bubble, while anger at Anthropic's hidden tool actions and Cloudflare's crawler accusation kept transparency on the agenda.
